gold: Inflammation-induced ocular neuropathy associated with SARS-CoV-2–induced panuveitis

selector.rationale: Positive nasopharyngeal swab RT-PCR for SARS-CoV-2 and recent close contact with a fatal case, along with specific ocular findings such as blurred vision, redness, and mild leakage associated with inferior peripapillary hemorrhage

rejected.why: No other neurological symptoms were observed

rejected.why: No relevant medical history was reported and normal complete blood cell counts
